question: Can conditioning be formally composed without collapsing directional order or admissibility context?

disposition.summary: Conditioned distinctions compose lawfully only when typed domain/codomain, directional order, conditioning lineage, and admissibility context are preserved. Composition attempts that erase order or collapse context are excluded.

formal_scaffold.candidate_condition: CondComp(<a>_b,<c>_d,x) holds only if Type(<a>_b), Type(<c>_d), OrderPreserved(b -> a, d -> c, x), LineagePreserved(b,d,x), AdmCtxPreserved(b,d,x), and NonCollapse all hold.
preservation_requirements: The meta-relation <*>_x is declared for the participating conditioned operands.
Directional conditioning order remains recoverable after composition.
Conditioning lineage remains recoverable after composition.
Admissibility context remains recoverable after composition.
The composition does not alias distinct conditioned classes or collapse them into arithmetic projection.
formal_scaffold.exclusion_rule: A composition is inadmissible if it erases conditioning order, suppresses lineage without declaration, collapses admissibility context, aliases distinct conditioned classes, or treats arithmetic projection as the primitive composition.

failure_conditions: Typed domain or codomain for conditioned composition is undeclared.
Directional order is erased or reversed without an explicit symmetry declaration.
Conditioning lineage is suppressed without a recoverable context record.
Admissibility context is collapsed or replaced by arithmetic projection.
Distinct conditioned classes are aliased after composition.
The composition is treated as commutative by default.
The result is used to promote unrestricted theorem status or physical causation.

remaining_work: Convert the campaign-supported composition scaffold into a formal proof artifact if theorem promotion is requested.
Run independent rigor endorsement before raising the conditioning induction ceiling.
Audit all uses of <*>_x over conditioned operands for recoverable order and lineage metadata.
Keep OQ_COND_002 through OQ_COND_005 separately tracked until each Appendix F item is synchronized.

does_not_prove: That arithmetic projection is the primitive composition.
Physical conditioning, causal spacetime propagation, or physical metric topology.
